arguments.name: build-catalog-app
arguments.prompt:
Build a Blazor Web App for a university course catalog in the existing project at `/tmp/sv-4dafd87244b647fdab4a276d323eaaf0/UniversityCourseCatalog`. The project was created with `dotnet new blazor --interactivity Server` and uses .NET 11 preview. It already has Bootstrap CSS included.

## Requirements
1. **Homepage** — featured courses and department links
2. **Browse/search/filter** — searchable, filterable list of departments and courses
3. **Course detail pages** — description, schedule, credits, instructor bio
4. **Enrollment request form** — name, student ID, course selection; standard HTML form, no wizards or real-time validation
5. No authentication
6. Intranet hosting (fast connectivity — Interactive Server rendering is perfect)

## Architecture decisions
- Use a simple in-memory data service (no database) with seed data
- Models: `Department`, `Course`, `Instructor`, `EnrollmentRequest`
- Service: `ICatalogService` registered as singleton
- All pages use Interactive Server render mode for search/filter interactivity

## What to create/modify

### 1. Models — create `Models/` directory
- `Department.cs`: Id, Name, Code (e.g. "CS"), Description
- `Course.cs`: Id, Title, Code (e.g. "CS 101"), Description, Credits (int), Schedule (string like "MWF 10:00-10:50 AM"), DepartmentId, InstructorId
- `Instructor.cs`: Id, Name, Title (e.g. "Professor"), Email, Bio, DepartmentId
- `EnrollmentRequest.cs`: Id, StudentName, StudentId, CourseId, SubmittedAt, Notes (optional)

### 2. Service — create `Services/` directory
- `ICatalogService.cs` and `CatalogService.cs`
- Methods: GetDepartments(), GetDepartment(id), GetCourses(departmentId?, searchTerm?), GetCourse(id), GetInstructor(id), SubmitEnrollmentRequest(request), GetFeaturedCourses()
- Seed with realistic university data: at least 5 departments (CS, Math, English, Physics, History), 3-4 courses each, 1-2 instructors per department
- Featured courses: return a curated subset (4-5 courses)

### 3. Register service in `Program.cs`
- Add `builder.Services.AddSingleton<ICatalogService, CatalogService>();`
- Add appropriate using statement

### 4. Update Navigation — `Components/Layout/NavMenu.razor`
Replace Counter and Weather links with:
- Home
- Courses (href="courses")
- Departments (href="departments") 
- Enroll (href="enroll")
Update the navbar brand to "Course Catalog"

### 5. Update Layout — `Components/Layout/MainLayout.razor`
Change the top-row link to say "University Course Catalog" instead of linking to ASP.NET docs

### 6. Pages — modify/create in `Components/Pages/`

**Delete**: `Counter.razor`, `Weather.razor`

**Modify `Home.razor`**:
- Hero section welcoming students
- Featured courses cards (use CatalogService)
- Department quick links
- Use `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Courses.razor`** (route: `/courses`):
- Search box (text input, bound to search term)
- Department filter dropdown
- Results list showing course code, title, credits, department
- Each course links to detail page
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `CourseDetail.razor`** (route: `/courses/{Id:int}`):
- Course title, code, credits, description
- Schedule information
- Instructor name, title, bio, email
- Department name
- Link to enroll in this course
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Departments.razor`** (route: `/departments`):
- List all departments with descriptions
- Each links to courses page filtered by that department
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Enroll.razor`** (route: `/enroll`):
- Standard EditForm with:
  - Student Name (required)
  - Student ID (required)
  - Course selection dropdown (required)
  - Notes (optional textarea)
  - Submit button
- On submit, call service and show success message
- Use DataAnnotationsValidator
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

### 7. Add `@using UniversityCourseCatalog.Models` and `@using UniversityCourseCatalog.Services` to `_Imports.razor`

### 8. Styling
Use Bootstrap classes throughout. Add any custom CSS needed to `wwwroot/app.css` for cards, hero section, etc. Keep it clean and professional.

### 9. After all changes, run `dotnet build` to verify everything compiles.

## Important notes
- The project uses .NET 11 preview. The `App.razor` uses `@Assets[]` syntax for static assets.
- Use `@rendermode InteractiveServer` on pages that need interactivity
- For the enrollment form, use `[Required]` and `[StringLength]` data annotations on the model
- Keep all seed data realistic — real-sounding course names, instructor bios, schedules, etc.

Build a Blazor Web App for a university course catalog in the existing project at `/tmp/sv-4dafd87244b647fdab4a276d323eaaf0/UniversityCourseCatalog`. The project was created with `dotnet new blazor --interactivity Server` and uses .NET 11 preview. It already has Bootstrap CSS included.

## Requirements
1. **Homepage** — featured courses and department links
2. **Browse/search/filter** — searchable, filterable list of departments and courses
3. **Course detail pages** — description, schedule, credits, instructor bio
4. **Enrollment request form** — name, student ID, course selection; standard HTML form, no wizards or real-time validation
5. No authentication
6. Intranet hosting (fast connectivity — Interactive Server rendering is perfect)

## Architecture decisions
- Use a simple in-memory data service (no database) with seed data
- Models: `Department`, `Course`, `Instructor`, `EnrollmentRequest`
- Service: `ICatalogService` registered as singleton
- All pages use Interactive Server render mode for search/filter interactivity

## What to create/modify

### 1. Models — create `Models/` directory
- `Department.cs`: Id, Name, Code (e.g. "CS"), Description
- `Course.cs`: Id, Title, Code (e.g. "CS 101"), Description, Credits (int), Schedule (string like "MWF 10:00-10:50 AM"), DepartmentId, InstructorId
- `Instructor.cs`: Id, Name, Title (e.g. "Professor"), Email, Bio, DepartmentId
- `EnrollmentRequest.cs`: Id, StudentName, StudentId, CourseId, SubmittedAt, Notes (optional)

### 2. Service — create `Services/` directory
- `ICatalogService.cs` and `CatalogService.cs`
- Methods: GetDepartments(), GetDepartment(id), GetCourses(departmentId?, searchTerm?), GetCourse(id), GetInstructor(id), SubmitEnrollmentRequest(request), GetFeaturedCourses()
- Seed with realistic university data: at least 5 departments (CS, Math, English, Physics, History), 3-4 courses each, 1-2 instructors per department
- Featured courses: return a curated subset (4-5 courses)

### 3. Register service in `Program.cs`
- Add `builder.Services.AddSingleton<ICatalogService, CatalogService>();`
- Add appropriate using statement

### 4. Update Navigation — `Components/Layout/NavMenu.razor`
Replace Counter and Weather links with:
- Home
- Courses (href="courses")
- Departments (href="departments") 
- Enroll (href="enroll")
Update the navbar brand to "Course Catalog"

### 5. Update Layout — `Components/Layout/MainLayout.razor`
Change the top-row link to say "University Course Catalog" instead of linking to ASP.NET docs

### 6. Pages — modify/create in `Components/Pages/`

**Delete**: `Counter.razor`, `Weather.razor`

**Modify `Home.razor`**:
- Hero section welcoming students
- Featured courses cards (use CatalogService)
- Department quick links
- Use `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Courses.razor`** (route: `/courses`):
- Search box (text input, bound to search term)
- Department filter dropdown
- Results list showing course code, title, credits, department
- Each course links to detail page
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `CourseDetail.razor`** (route: `/courses/{Id:int}`):
- Course title, code, credits, description
- Schedule information
- Instructor name, title, bio, email
- Department name
- Link to enroll in this course
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Departments.razor`** (route: `/departments`):
- List all departments with descriptions
- Each links to courses page filtered by that department
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

**Create `Enroll.razor`** (route: `/enroll`):
- Standard EditForm with:
  - Student Name (required)
  - Student ID (required)
  - Course selection dropdown (required)
  - Notes (optional textarea)
  - Submit button
- On submit, call service and show success message
- Use DataAnnotationsValidator
- `@rendermode InteractiveServer`

### 7. Add `@using UniversityCourseCatalog.Models` and `@using UniversityCourseCatalog.Services` to `_Imports.razor`

### 8. Styling
Use Bootstrap classes throughout. Add any custom CSS needed to `wwwroot/app.css` for cards, hero section, etc. Keep it clean and professional.

### 9. After all changes, run `dotnet build` to verify everything compiles.

## Important notes
- The project uses .NET 11 preview. The `App.razor` uses `@Assets[]` syntax for static assets.
- Use `@rendermode InteractiveServer` on pages that need interactivity
- For the enrollment form, use `[Required]` and `[StringLength]` data annotations on the model
- Keep all seed data realistic — real-sounding course names, instructor bios, schedules, etc.
